verdict.rationale: Grafana has a published OpenAPI spec (probe) and documented programmatic surfaces: dashboards, data sources and other configuration can be defined in code, and a CLI handles administrative tasks for CI/CD. Nothing in the evidence shows that every UI action has an API equivalent. missing for 10: documented UI-to-API parity statement, evidence that the API covers alerting/SLO/incident/on-call management, endpoint-level API reference docs, independent hands-on corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This approach lets you define dashboards, data sources, and other configurations in code, enabling version control, automated testing, and reliable deployments through CI/CD pipelines.
You can authenticate, manage multiple environments, and perform administrative tasks from the terminal.
